title: WebTables: Exploring the Power of Tables on the Web
authors: Michael J. Cafarella, Alon Halevy, Daisy Zhe Wang, Eugene Wu, Yang Zhang
description: Presents the WebTables system, which extracts 154 million high-quality relational tables from a web crawl of 14.1 billion HTML tables and introduces the Attribute Correlation Statistics Database (ACSDb) to enable schema auto-complete, attribute synonym finding, and join-graph traversal at web scale.
